results.title: Unauthenticated protected-route redirect
results.actual_result: Direct dashboard, active test, and lesson URLs each redirected an unauthenticated browser to /login.

results.title: Student login to dashboard
results.actual_result: Username login issued a browser session and rendered the student dashboard.

results.title: Student dashboard profile and progress
results.actual_result: Dashboard loaded profile and progress sections through the local HTTP API.

results.title: Dashboard lists recently updated lessons and materials
results.actual_result: Dashboard displayed the recently updated published lesson and material using safe metadata without file URLs or filesystem paths.

results.title: Dashboard shows uncompleted work and upcoming deadlines
results.actual_result: Dashboard listed the unsubmitted homework and exam with their configured deadlines.

results.title: Student cannot open admin routes
results.actual_result: Student role was redirected away from the admin route.

results.title: Student course list shows enrolled course
results.actual_result: Enrolled synthetic course was returned by the real API and rendered.

results.title: Lesson content and HTML sanitization
results.actual_result: Lesson rendered; embedded script and event-handler attributes were removed before insertion.

results.title: Revisit lesson and preserve navigation
results.actual_result: The same published lesson reloaded with the next-lesson action present.

results.title: Preview authorized PDF material
results.actual_result: PDF.js rendered page 1 with nonblank canvas pixels (711×919); navigation rendered page 2 of 3 and returned to page 1.

results.title: Download authorized PDF material
results.actual_result: Browser downloaded the exact authorized three-page PDF fixture (2254 bytes, SHA-256 matched).

results.title: Vocabulary detail and flashcard interaction
results.actual_result: The TOEIC chapter list opened one grouped flashcard, saved the chapter, and exposed both words with pronunciation, meanings and examples on its reverse.

results.title: Search vocabulary by keyword
results.actual_result: Search matched chapter words using case-insensitive English and accent-insensitive Vietnamese text, then showed the empty state for an unrelated query.

results.title: Deny download when material policy forbids it
results.actual_result: The authorized Student rendered the restricted PDF inline, the row exposed no Download button, Preview returned HTTP 200 and Download returned HTTP 403.

results.title: Assessment start, autosave, refresh and scoring
results.actual_result: Both answers persisted across refresh; submission produced 2/2 and a terminal database record.

results.title: Confirm submission lists unanswered questions
results.actual_result: Submission confirmation reported 16/20 answered and explicitly listed unanswered questions 5, 8, 12 and 19.

results.title: Result includes score, counts, duration and pass classification
results.actual_result: The result view showed score/max score, correct count, elapsed time and pass classification.

results.title: Hidden-answer configuration conceals the answer key
results.actual_result: With showCorrectAnswers disabled, the submitted result did not render correct-answer labels or highlighted correct options.

results.title: Dashboard shows completed assessment result
results.actual_result: Dashboard showed the completed assessment title, 2/2 score, pass result and submitted date.

results.title: Countdown timer warns in red below five minutes
results.actual_result: Server deadline under three minutes rendered the warning timer in the danger color; the remaining time stayed minute-second formatted.

results.title: Assessment auto-submits when the server deadline expires
results.actual_result: Timer expiry automatically submitted the attempt; the isolated database recorded a terminal expired result.

results.title: History lists the submitted assessment and result
results.actual_result: History listed all 3 submitted attempts with date/time, score/max score, pass result and duration.

results.title: Logout clears browser session
results.actual_result: Logout cleared the local access token and returned the browser to /login.

results.title: Invalid password is rejected on login screen
results.actual_result: Invalid password stayed on /login and displayed the expected Vietnamese error without a session token.

results.title: Suspended student is blocked at login
results.actual_result: Suspended account received an account-status page and was not issued a browser session.

results.title: Admin creates a student through the management screen
results.actual_result: Admin UI created an active student in the isolated DB; persisted password is hashed.

results.title: Admin student profile shows learning and exam history
results.actual_result: Admin profile showed the student lesson-progress row and the scored Standard assessment attempt.

results.title: Admin student search ignores Vietnamese accents and case
results.actual_result: The admin list matched the same Vietnamese full name with accentless lowercase and accented uppercase queries.

results.title: Suspension blocks an already-authenticated student
results.actual_result: Suspension revoked the active session and blocked its protected API request; admin activation then allowed a fresh login.

results.title: Student changes password and signs in with the new password
results.actual_result: The current password was accepted, the new bcrypt password persisted, and the new password authenticated successfully.

results.title: Wrong current password is rejected without updating the hash
results.actual_result: The incorrect current password was rejected and the previously accepted password remained valid.

results.title: Admin reporting returns submitted attempt
results.actual_result: Admin results screen listed the attempt saved by the student exam flow.

results.title: Private file URL rejects unauthenticated request
results.actual_result: Unauthenticated direct request was denied (HTTP 401).

results.title: Passwords are hashed at rest in the test database
results.actual_result: Seeded login password is stored as a bcrypt hash, not plaintext.

results.title: Dashboard at desktop, tablet and mobile widths
results.actual_result: No horizontal overflow at 1920px, 768px, 375px, 412px viewports.

results.title: Mobile question sheet opens and shows unanswered questions
results.actual_result: Mobile sheet navigated to a question and the submit modal listed both unanswered questions.
